title: Understanding Event Loops in Node.js
content: The Event Loop is what allows Node.js to perform non-blocking I/O operations despite JavaScript being single-threaded. It offloads operations to the system kernel whenever possible.

title: Why MongoDB Fits Modern Web Apps
content: MongoDB's flexible schema approach allows developers to iterate quickly without spending hours managing complex relational database migrations in early phases.

title: Stateless vs Stateful Authentication
content: Stateless auth using JWTs eliminates the need to keep session state in server memory, making horizontal scaling across multiple application instances seamless.

title: Mastering the Clean Architecture Pattern
content: Separating controllers, services, and models ensures your core business logic remains independent of the database and external HTTP delivery mechanisms.

title: Optimizing Query Performance with Indexing
content: Database indexes decrease query execution times from linear scans to logarithmic log-time lookups. Always index fields used in frequent lookups and sorting.

title: A Quick Primer on Big O Notation
content: Big O notation measures the efficiency of an algorithm in terms of time and space execution as the input size grows toward infinity.

title: Why You Should Avoid `.skip()` in Production
content: Mongoose `.skip()` scans past every document before returning results, resulting in linear O(n) degradation on large datasets. Use cursor-based pagination instead.

title: Introduction to Vector Search in AI Applications
content: Vector embeddings represent complex unstructured data as dense numerical arrays, allowing vector databases to perform high-dimensional similarity searches.
